name: io.github.wellknownmcp/hoshin-kanri
title: Hoshin Kanri X-Matrix
description: Strategic memory agents can build, score and keep current: a living X-Matrix with review cadences.

highlights: Claude plugin with six skills (marketplace wellknownmcp/hoshin-kanri): the connector and the know-how to build a strategy, run its reviews and share it
show_matrix: the X-Matrix and its initiative cards drawn in the conversation as an MCP App
Review cycle: get_agenda tells a recurring agent what is due; record_review keeps the decisions and a snapshot of the matrix; get_review reads it back
KPI readings by period with their source, initiative sheets and KPI definitions, so every agent computes a number the same way
audience external: elements marked internal, figures and names never leave the organization, for agents and public links alike
export_matrix_image: SVG or PNG for a deck, vision at the bottom or on top, or one page per initiative
create_matrix, upsert_element, set_correlation: an agent builds a strategy from nothing; get_cascade links group, unit and site matrices
A completeness score that returns a verdict: coverage, correlation density, orphan elements, vision-to-KPI chains, leading/lagging balance
OAuth 2.1 with Client ID Metadata Documents and dynamic registration; MCP revisions 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25
Sovereign local JSON mode: the same 42 tools, data never leaves your machine
